## Home
- Replaced the old F with the Veylo V/play logo.
- Added compact category filters and consistent thumbnail spacing.
- Made Continue Watching cards smaller and removed the visible X. Long-press still opens video actions.

## Shorts
- Added white outline action icons, compact labels, and a smaller overlay header.
- Added subtle edge fades to keep captions and controls readable.

## Library and navigation
- Added a Playlists shortcut at the top of Library, including empty libraries.
- Added a small teal indicator for the selected navigation tab.

## Installation
This official release updates the official Veylo 3.0.0 app. Test builds use a separate app ID and cannot be updated with official APKs.
